'''Lotus (AM-11)'''<ref name="terminal">[[The Whitespring Resort terminal entries#Week of 10/11/77|The Whitespring Resort terminal entries; Maintenance room terminal, Maintenance Logs; Week of 10/11/77]]</ref> is a deactivated [[Assaultron (Fallout 76)|Assaultron]] at [[the Whitespring Resort]].

==Background==
Originally an attendant at the Whitespring Spa, Lotus was involved in "spa incidents" that left several guests with spinal injuries.<ref>[[The Whitespring Resort terminal entries#10/15/77: RE: Ironclad Status|The Whitespring Resort teminal entries; General Manager's terminal, The Whitespring Corporate IntraMail, 10/15/77: RE: Ironclad Status]]</ref> After being deactivated, Lotus was replaced by AM-12 [[Vera (Fallout 76)|Vera]].<ref name="terminal" /> The deactivated Lotus can still be found in a maintenance room on the second floor, near the dining room.

'''Mire's Eye''', previously known as the '''mirelurk den''', is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in [[the Mire]] region of [[Appalachia]] {{in|FO76BP}}. To reach the location, head far northeast of [[Freddy Fear's House of Scares]], and follow the river north. Turn east from a pond area with several [[Brain fungus (Fallout 76)|brain fungi]] to find a red door leading to the den.

==Background==
{{Section|FO76AC}}

==Layout==
Mire's Eye is on the far northeast edge of the map, north of [[Freddy Fear's House of Scares]] and east of an unmarked pond with [[Brain fungus (Fallout 76)|brain fungi]]. After going through the door, the player enters from the southern direction. In the center of the den is a dead [[Mirelurk queen (Fallout 76)|mirelurk queen]], strung up on display by the [[Blood Eagles]], who occupy this location. To the east is an area with wooden fortifications, as well as crates, bedding and a rack for [[Fish (Fallout 76)|fish]]. To the west are some elevated platforms with cooking equipment. To the north is an equipment and storage area with two caged cells. A [[Power armor (Fallout 76)|power armored]] Blood Eagle is found here. Against the stone wall in this area is a button which opens the wall to reveal a secret compartment. It opens to a cave area that acts as an armory, with many weapons and [[Ammo box (Fallout 76)|ammo boxes]] found inside.

==Notable loot==
* [[Mirelurk den (note)|Mirelurk den]] - Note, on a table in the eastern bedding area.
* [[Mirelurk Medley]] - Note, on a table next to a large skewer in the cooking area.
* At least 16 [[Glowing fungus (Fallout 76)|glowing fungi]], including two at the exterior entrance and 14 in the interior itself.

==Notes==
Mirelurk hatchlings that spawn in this location are called "Blood Eagle Hatchlings." This is likely due to the [[Mirelurk den (note)|mirelurk den]] note, in which the author states the hatchlings had "taken a liking to us."<ref>[[Mirelurk den (note)]]</ref>

==Appearances==
Mire's Eye appears only {{In|FO76BP}}.

==Behind the scenes==
This location was initially added to the game's files with the ''[[Steel Dawn]]'' [[Fallout 76 updates|update]], but was not implemented and was left as [[Fallout 76 unused content|unused content]]. In the files, it was known as the '''raider den'''. It was not added to the live game map until ''Boardwalk Paradise'', as an unmarked location known as the '''mirelurk den'''. It shared this distinction with the [[deserted mine]]. With the following ''[[America's Playground]]'' update, the location was given a map marker and renamed to Mire's Eye.
